maddeler.e:
نخرنمس (form IIIq)
# نَخْرَنْمِسُ (naḵranmisu) /nax.ran.mi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# نَخْرَنْمِسَ (naḵranmisa) /nax.ran.mi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# نَخْرَنْمِسْ (naḵranmis) /nax.ran.mis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
